## Change

Explain the problem or creative addition and resulting behaviour.

## Validation

List checks actually run, with results. Include screenshots for visual changes.

## Continuity and provenance

Identify affected canon records and source/permission details for new creative assets. Write “none” if not applicable.

## Risk and follow-up

Identify user-facing risk, rollback steps, accessibility impact and anything that still needs a maintainer decision. Write “none” if not applicable.
